Here’s a closeup of texture of the quilt. The underside is a darker green (more bluish gray) and the miffy heads are on the back too. The miffy parts are like a soft gauze material and the rest of the quilt is a slightly rougher cotton shell that’s a bit scratchy. Maybe it’ll soften with washes idk. It’s very thin. Like 1-2 mm at best (think towel) but the edge is doubled up so it’s a bit thicker (~1cm). You could use it as a throw but I wouldn’t use it to sleep unless your house is like 80F+ or you have something else under it.
